{{Quote|This encryption is a pattern I don't recognize, Commander!''"<br />"''<nowiki></nowiki>''Keep working'' on it, Six-Ten&mdash;we need to find out what's in that file!|Six-Ten and [[Unidentified clone trooper commander (Separatist factory)|his commander]]|<ref name="Update" />}}
'''Six-Ten''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served as part of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
In around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]] and the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] launched a [[Raid on a Separatist factory|raid]] on a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Unidentified Separatist factory|factory]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. They were tasked with stealing an encrypted file on a [[Datachip/Legends|data chip]], one crucial to the Confederacy of Independent Systems. The Separatist [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] discovered this and attacked the [[Cloning/Legends|clones]]. Six-Ten was tasked with decrypting the file, which forced him to rush. He attempted to decrypt the file, while his fellow soldiers held off the [[Droid/Legends|droids]].<ref name="Update" />

The droids overwhelmed the clones outside of the facility and entered the building. The clone troopers inside were killed, including Six-Ten, who was shot in the head. Unfortunately, a [[Unidentified B1 battle droid (Separatist factory)|B1 battle droid]] recovered the chip and escaped in a [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle/Legends|''Sheathipede''-class transport shuttle]], just before clone reinforcements arrived on the scene.<ref name="Update" />
